title: Component of the normalized integral presentation pullback square
statement: For every pro-etale test object W of U, the components at W of the two morphisms in the normalized integral presentation pullback square are equal.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2 and Section 6.8; pointwise finite-quotient comparison

proof.text: Compose each component with every finite quotient projection. The finite constant and residue normalization equations identify both component maps pointwise; the inverse-limit projections then determine the component uniquely.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 6.8.2 and Section 6.8; pointwise finite-quotient comparison
